InfoPoints.Title: SECTION 2
InfoPoints.Body:
Pulling the TRIGGER in open space will activate a MANUAL TELEPORT. HOLD the TRIGGER to see a projection of where you will travel.

If the laser colour is:
- GREEN, you are able to teleport.
- RED, you are unable to teleport.

RELEASE the TRIGGER to confirm your action.

TELEPORT to the next platform to continue.
